2609.37378.title: Do-JEPA: From Masking to Intervention in Latent World Models
2609.37378.paper_summary: Latent world models are trained to predict what happens next, so nothing in their objective separates what an action caused from what merely co-occurred with it. Object-masking models such as C-JEPA intervene on what the predictor can see; we intervene on what physically happens. From one saved simulator state we run the dynamics under an action $a$ and under a reference action $a_{\varnothing}$, and train the model to predict the difference $Δz=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$ between the two latent futures. The resulting objective, Do-JEPA, has an effect loss, a support loss (where the action enters), a propagation loss (where its effect travels) and invariance losses (what must not change). In a synthetic system with object-aligned variables, support supervision finds the directly intervened object in 99.95% of test cases, where a sparse action mask sends the action to a nuisance slot in every case, and response-onset supervision recovers the ring-shaped propagation graph (edge AUROC 0.975 vs. 0.624). From pixels, the effect loss beats a control trained on exactly the same data: it lowers latent effect error by 28.4% on an end-to-end LeWM model and physical effect error by 13.5% when trained and tested on natural action sequences, and on three independently generated CausalWorld benchmarks it lowers responsive effect error by about 20% under physics shifts and the latent context sensitivity of predicted effects by 66%. Trained from scratch it costs factual accuracy; fine-tuning an existing model with it removes this cost. Together, these results show that intervening on the world, rather than on what the model sees, helps latent world models predict what their actions cause.
2609.37378.paper_summary_zh: 潛在世界模型被訓練來預測接下來會發生什麼，因此它們的目標中沒有區分行動所造成的結果與僅僅與之同時發生的事件。物體遮罩模型如 C-JEPA 介入於預測器所能看到的內容；我們則介入於實際發生的事情。從一個保存的模擬器狀態，我們在行動 $a$ 和參考行動 $a_{\varnothing}$ 下運行動力學，並訓練模型預測兩個潛在未來之間的差異 $Δz=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$。最終的目標 Do-JEPA 包含效果損失、支持損失（行動進入的地方）、傳播損失（其效果傳播的地方）和不變性損失（必須不改變的部分）。在一個具有物體對齊變數的合成系統中，支持監督在 99.95% 的測試案例中找到了直接介入的物體，其中稀疏的行動遮罩在每個案例中將行動發送到一個干擾槽，而反應開始監督則恢復了環形傳播圖（邊緣 AUROC 0.975 對 0.624）。從像素來看，效果損失超越了一個在完全相同數據上訓練的控制模型：在端到端的 LeWM 模型上，它將潛在效果誤差降低了 28.4%，在自然行動序列上訓練和測試時將物理效果誤差降低了 13.5%，並且在三個獨立生成的 CausalWorld 基準上，它在物理變化下將反應效果誤差降低了約 20%，以及將預測效果的潛在上下文敏感性降低了 66%。從零開始訓練會影響事實準確性；用它微調現有模型則消除了這一成本。總體而言，這些結果顯示，介入世界而不是模型所見的內容，有助於潛在世界模型預測其行動所造成的結果。
2609.37378.author: Hossein Resani et.al.
